desc:
[Indo City Square] 

No need for small talk. Here, the streets are our home, and solidarity is the price of life.

Indo City Brawl is not a place for those who just want to be safe. Sector Zero has already witnessed the history of who has the courage and who is just a coward. This city is tough, and every part of its territory must be conquered through effort, not just by begging.

Why do you have to be here?

Realistic, Not Just Promises: We're building this city so you can feel it. Not just a game, but an ambition to explore every corner of the streets.

Non-Stop Clashes: The system we've created focuses on smooth action. Forget about the lag that makes you die ridiculously. Here, the skills and agility of your group will determine who stands last. 

Street Rules: There's no seniority, it's just who's more solid. Invite your friends, build a group name, and let everyone know who the real ruler of Sector Zero is.

Remember:
In this city, big names don't come from rumors.
